answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the wander is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest nebula a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the anchor is shared, not multiplied. Seal 11mlc.
